items.subject: The Layer-2 per-repo entry-point contract (folder shape, thread-block convention, honest-coverage discipline)
items.fact: docs/repos/README.md defines a settled, owner-ratified contract for per-repo entry points: a folder is a handoff not documentation; it is canonical for nothing and every file states what it summarises, which document is canonical, and the date it was true; the earned file set is README.md + capabilities.md + records.md + working-here.md (current-state.md and goals.md deferred, owner 2026-08-08); it holds one dated block per active/paused/closed thread that a session replaces individually rather than rewriting the file; a built folder ships with its doc-route pair in the same PR; coverage is on-demand and blank rows mean 'not built', never 'nothing happening'; and maintenance is a session-close step with an explicit null, deliberately not a gate. This is the rule set the successor's repositories/ tier needs; the coverage table and per-folder build dates in the same file are dated provenance and stay archived.
